note: Dollars of construction put in place. Not megawatts. Not added to a counted kind. Does not change counted IT load.

definitions.dataCenter: Includes buildings that contain the hardware needed for storing, processing, and transmitting digital information.
definitions.general: Includes administration buildings, computer centers, office buildings, and professional buildings.
definitions.office: In addition to the types of offices listed below, it also includes motion picture, television, and radio offices.
definitions.racksOrServers: racks or servers in data centers

dataCenterSearch.result: No Census construction spending series for data centers. The Census-tagged hits were discontinued purchased computer services series, not value of construction put in place.
